notes: RoutrToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Routr Network (ROUTR) with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. It has no owner, external mint or burn functions, transfer fees, or upgrade mechanism. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
